strict.criterion: Full-visual-realism virtual environments displace ordinary text chat rooms.
strict.rationale: Early virtual worlds did not provide full realism or replace mainstream text conversation in 2009. Widely used text-centered collaboration and messaging persist alongside virtual environments. Coexistence is not replacement.

broader.criterion: 3D virtual spaces become a real social meeting medium alongside text messaging.
broader.rationale: Social VR platforms and 3D virtual worlds offer genuine social spaces, earning partial credit. Even under a charitable reading, however, text chat has expanded rather than disappeared, and VR spaces are neither photorealistic nor a replacement for text messaging.
changedConditions: Credits social virtual environments as partial without treating coexistence as replacement of text chat
